summary: Phase 1 (Cluster A — malformed JSDoc remediation + recurrence guard) is correct. The FR-3 balanced-brace guard detects all three fixture failure modes (3 violations / exit 1) and reports zero violations across apps/, packages/, convex/ (exit 0). All 6 source-file fixes are JSDoc-only edits with no logic or signature changes. The 144-file restore returned the working tree to HEAD (10 sampled paths show zero diff). The corrected generator template covers the FR-1/FR-2 failure modes with three clear rules. Targeted tests pass; no new TypeScript or lint errors were introduced by the modified files.

nonblocking_findings.description: FR-2 step C (re-run the JSDoc generator across the 144 files and verify zero violations before committing) was not executed. The 144-file working-tree batch was instead restored to HEAD, and the corrected template was committed for future regeneration. The deviation is documented and justified in plan.md by the agent-driven, non-checked-in nature of the generator. The safety goal is still met because the FR-3 guard reports 0 violations across the production scope.

No lessons-learned.md entry was added for the JSDoc generator anti-pattern in Phase 1. This is acceptable because FR-20 (document the test-integrity / anti-pattern standard in lessons-learned) is explicitly scheduled for Phase 7. Recommend folding the generator prompt invariant into that Phase 7 entry.

Targeted lint and tsc runs surface only pre-existing issues unrelated to the 6 modified files: 2 lint warnings in apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/lib/onboarding/student-flow.test.ts and a pre-existing TS2769 error at apps/integrated-math-3/components/dev/review-queue/index.tsx:45 that existed at baseline e195fded. The JSDoc edits in that file are at line 493.
